title: Emrys and the Signal
author: Astrid Sterling
blurb: Ada Dunmore, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
